subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should OpenClaw accept this `sessions.activity`/`session.activity`/plugin-hook contract now, or should the PR wait for the canonical per-session activity and attention-state design to settle?
rationale: The branch defines public Gateway and plugin SDK activity semantics while the canonical activity issue is still open, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent API/product boundary.

options.title: Align Contract And Repair Before Merge
options.body: Resolve conflicts, reuse the current session/agent matcher, and land only the activity API shape maintainers explicitly accept.

options.title: Accept This API Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can approve the new RPC, event, and hooks as the initial public contract despite narrower attention/stale-run semantics.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Keep the work open or close/reopen later after the broader activity issue defines durable attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics.

recommendation.title: Align Contract And Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, reuse the current session/agent matcher, and land only the activity API shape maintainers explicitly accept.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical activity-contract issue and has recent history on both session matching and plugin hook contracts.
